title: Lower Bounds for Smooth Nonconvex Zeroth-Order Optimization: The Price of Determinism under Low Curvature Trace
abstract: arXiv:2610.27550v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Low curvature trace, an effective rank condition, is a common explanation for why randomized zeroth-order methods scale to high-dimensional tasks such as language model fine-tuning. Can deterministic methods achieve the same savings? We show that they cannot. We study finding $\varepsilon$-stationary points of $L$-smooth nonconvex functions on $\mathbb{R}^d$ from exact function values, assuming that below the starting value the Hessian is dominated by a fixed matrix with trace at most $LE$; this is the effective rank condition used to explain zeroth-order fine-tuning. When $ET\le d$, the Gaussian two-point method that such fine-tuning uses needs only $O(ET)$ calls if it rejects steps that raise $f$, where $T=L\Delta/\varepsilon^2$ is the iteration count of gradient descent from initial gap $\Delta$, and we prove that every randomized method needs $\Omega(ET)$ calls, so this cost is optimal up to constants. translated_title: 光滑非凸零阶优化的下界：低曲率迹条件下确定性的代价
translated_abstract: 低曲率迹（low curvature trace）是一种有效秩条件，常被用来解释随机化零阶方法为何能扩展到语言模型微调等高维任务。确定性方法能否获得同样的节省？我们证明它们不能。我们研究仅凭精确函数值在 ℝ^d 上寻找 L-光滑非凸函数 ε-驻点的问题，并假设在初始值以下 Hessian 被一个迹至多为 LE 的固定矩阵所支配；这正是用于解释零阶微调的有效秩条件。当 ET≤d 时，此类微调所采用的高斯两点法只要拒绝使 f 上升的步，就只需 O(ET) 次函数调用，其中 T=LΔ/ε² 是从初始间隙 Δ 出发的梯度下降迭代次数；我们还证明任何随机化方法都需要 Ω(ET) 次调用，因此该复杂度在常数因子内是最优的。相比之下，每个确定性方法……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 本文在低曲率迹（有效秩）条件下证明了随机化零阶非凸优化仅需 O(ET) 次函数调用且在常数因子内最优，而任何确定性方法都无法获得这种依赖有效秩的节省，从而量化了确定性方法的固有代价。
en_tdlr: Under a low-curvature-trace (effective rank) condition, this paper proves that O(ET) function evaluations for randomized zeroth-order nonconvex optimization are optimal up to constants, while every deterministic method provably cannot achieve the same savings—quantifying the price of determinism.
